voyages.note: Laying 13-27 July from the noon positions telegraphed from the ship (Lloyd's List; the Sun and the Express, London), checked against the U.S. Hydrographic Office chart of 1869-71, and the Herald's daily runs. Sheerness-Berehaven and the 1865-cable recovery (9 Aug - 8 Sep) are approximate; the completion of the 1865 cable follows the chart's dated positions.
